code_safety.reason: scored on the declared repository at version 0.2.16, because the published package carries its code only as build output, which is not read as the server's own source; 1 vendored or minified path was excluded before scanning; machine-generated bundles are not the server's own code

evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: source was fetched but every file in it was oversized, unreadable or excluded, so no source text could be read, and no credential header is declared. An undeclared header is not an absent one — measured 2026-09-15, only 10 of 100 remotes declare one at all — so `03` §4's "no authentication" band is not established.

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared endpoint(s) are HTTPS: https://mcp.xyzzylabs.ai/wasm/mcp; scored 80, not 100: `03` §4 reserves 100 for HTTPS *with HSTS*, and an HSTS header can only be seen by connecting, which `04` §9 does not do. This is an unverifiable band, not an observed absence.

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 4 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Hex High Entropy String). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Hex High Entropy String at build/wasm-proposals-main.json:1; Hex High Entropy String at build/wasm-sections-js-api-main.json:1; Hex High Entropy String at build/wasm-sections-web-api-main.json:1; Hex High Entropy String at build/wasm-spec-core-main.json:1
